name: Roar
description: When a creature roars all creatures with hearing within 30 feet of it must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened until the end of the creature’s next turn. If the target fails the saving throw by 5 or more, it’s also paralyzed for the same duration. A target that succeeds on the saving throw is immune to the Roar of all mahoru for the next 24 hours.
